## Scope

Describe the observable product or documentation change and the authoritative files changed.

## Custody and rights

- [ ] The change remains within the MIT-licensed public source boundary.
- [ ] No private development history, canonical source copies, workstation paths, or host-private traces were introduced.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, live Officefiles, or unintended host-private captures are included.

## Customer journey

List affected customer documentation links, or state why no customer guidance changes.

## Verification

List commands run, observed results, independent review, and any skipped or unavailable check.

## Claim boundary

State what this change proves and what remains unobserved, including installation, discovery, activation, native rendering, calculation, accessibility, delivery, or representative-user evidence where relevant.
